plain: One of a short list of things Claude's constitution says Claude must never do, whatever anyone asks.
eli5: A rule with no exceptions, like never playing with matches, even if someone says it is fine.
technical: In Claude's constitution (Anthropic 2026), one of seven absolute restrictions (for example serious uplift toward mass-casualty weapons, or generating CSAM) that act as a boundary on the actions Claude considers, not as one weight among others; the Model Spec's red lines are the closest match, while its Root level is not.
